# Developer's Reasoning

## Root Cause
The bug is in the 'find_best' function in 'pipeline.py', specifically with the variable '_last_best'. When no record exceeds the threshold, '_last_best' retains the value from a previous call instead of being reset, leading to stale data being returned.

## Failure Mechanism
If 'load_and_validate' returns an empty list for 'valid' (i.e., no records pass the validation rules), and none of the records exceed the threshold, the 'best' variable is assigned the value of '_last_best', which may not be valid for the current call. This results in returning an outdated record instead of None.

## Broken Invariant
The function 'find_best' must return None if no records meet the criteria of passing validation and exceeding the threshold. Returning a stale '_last_best' violates this contract.

## Fix Strategy
The fix involves explicitly setting '_last_best' to None when no valid records exceed the threshold. This ensures that if no current records qualify, the function will correctly return None instead of an outdated record.
